description: React component for mobile layout of challenge editor, including tab navigation, preview portal handling, and mobile-specific UI adjustments.

classes.name: MobileLayout
classes.description: React component managing the mobile layout for challenge editor, including tab switching, preview handling, and mobile UI adjustments.

methods.name: switchTab
methods.description: Switches the current tab in the mobile layout.

methods.name: setToolPanelPosition
methods.description: Adjusts the position of the tool panel based on viewport size and keyboard visibility.

methods.name: isMobileDevice
methods.description: Detects if the current device is a mobile device based on user agent.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up event listeners and initializes tool panel position on mount.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listeners and resets styles on unmount.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events to update keyboard usage state.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles click events to update keyboard usage state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the mobile layout including tabs, preview portal, and controls.
